roadmap.title: NEET-PG 2026 counselling roadmap
roadmap.source: MCC tentative schedule, notice of 7 Oct 2026. State rounds follow each MCC round; confirm with your state authority.

stages.name: Registration
stages.detail: Round 1 registration and payment (12–21 Oct, till 12 noon) and choice locking (until 22 Oct, 10 am).

stages.name: Round 1 result
stages.detail: Result on 24 Oct. Join or upload documents 26 Oct – 2 Nov: freeze (join in person) or float (upload online). Free exit in this round.

stages.name: Round 2
stages.detail: Seats newly approved by NMC were sent to MCC on 3 Nov; institutes verify the seat matrix by 6 Nov and Round 2 is expected from 7 Nov (revised schedule awaited). Not joining or resigning forfeits the security deposit.

stages.name: Round 3
stages.detail: Registration 26 Nov – 1 Dec, choice locking until 2 Dec, 10 am, result 4 Dec, reporting 5–12 Dec. No resignation; not joining loses the deposit and ends MCC counselling.

stages.name: Stray vacancy
stages.detail: Registration 16–21 Dec, choices close 21 Dec, 11:55 pm, result 24 Dec, reporting 24–31 Dec. Final round: a seat here must be joined.

Some tuition fees on the KEA option entry fee portal look wrong (for example Dr B.R. Ambedkar Medical College, Q quota, and Sri Basaveshwara Medical College, Chitradurga, now a state university). Check the fee again after the mock allotment.
Round 1 revised seat matrix published.
2026 information bulletin and Round 1 schedule: registration 2 Nov, 2 pm – 5 Nov, 10 am.
Round 1 choice filling and locking closed 1 Nov, 11:59 pm.
NEIGRIHMS: Round 1 willingness for online counselling by email closed 1 Nov, 4 pm.
Merit list, seat matrix and Round 1 allotment now on the Chhattisgarh roadmap: 874 candidates, 453 state and NRI seats, 278 allotted. Find your CMR by NEET-PG rank or name.

Rank lists now searchable on the Tamil Nadu roadmap: Government quota (7,969), Management quota (3,644) and DNB/diploma (71), with every addendum and the CMC, minority, NRI and PwD eligibility marked; and the Round 1 seat matrix (2,430 seats).
UP on the roadmap: state merit lists (6,084 MD/MS and 96 DNB), the Round 1 seat matrix (4,125 seats) and the Round 1 allotment (2,904 seats, 2 Nov).
Uttarakhand on the roadmap: updated merit list (1,021) and NRI list, the seat matrix (488 seats) and the Round 1 allotment broadsheet (315 allotted).
MCC Round 2: newly approved seats were sent to MCC on 3 Nov; institutes verify the seat matrix by 6 Nov, so Round 2 is expected to start from 7 Nov. Await the revised official schedule.
Round 1 MD/MS and DNB allotment out. Report and download the allotment letter 3–7 Nov and 12–13 Nov, with original documents, the registration form and the security deposit slip.
Round 1 provisional allotment (regular and NRI) out. Allotment letters after 4 pm on 4 Nov; discrepancies until 4 Nov, 2 pm; report by 10 Nov.
Round 1 final allotment list out: join by 10 Nov, 4 pm. Travancore Medical College, Kollam seat matrix and the self-financing college fee structure also published.
Revised Round 1 schedule: the result will be published on 6 Nov.
Round 1 provisional selection list. Representations to helpdeskjakbopee@gmail.com until 4 Nov, 11 am; reporting 4 Nov, 2 pm – 7 Nov, 4:30 pm (resignation until then).
Round 1 provisional seat allotment and updated seat matrix published.

Mock round option entry extended to 3 Nov, noon. Mock allotment published, withdrawn and republished after errors (management quota seats were missing). Revised provisional fee structure, with St John's and Shri Basaveshwara (Chitradurga) fee orders. Change options from 3 Nov, 5 pm to 5 Nov, 10 am.
Round 1 reporting withheld. The High Court (interim order of 2 Nov) limited in-service candidates to their 30% quota; next hearing 5 Nov, 2:30 pm. Bond submission for upgradation published 2 Nov.

Round 1 final provisional merit lists (including in-service) and the provisional seat matrices for MD/MS (government, corporation, central and aided colleges; private and minority colleges) and diploma published.
RIMS Round 1 schedule: online registration, choice filling and locking, and document verification 3–10 Nov.
Round 1 upgraded allotment guidelines published. Choice locking closes today, 3 Nov, 11:55 pm.
Round 1 provisional allotment. Objections closed 3 Nov, 5 pm.
Round 1 provisional result. Reporting, document verification, allotment letter and fee payment from 3 Nov.
Addendum to the provisional rank lists (Government and Management quota). Round 1 registration and choice locking close 3 Nov, 5 pm.
Round 1 registration open until 5 Nov, 10 am; choice filling 3 Nov, 5 pm – 5 Nov, 5 pm.
NEET PG 2026 medical admission guidelines published.

Round 1 reporting at help centres 2–6 Nov (10 am – 4 pm); tuition fee at Axis Bank 2–6 Nov (10:30 am – 2 pm). NRI candidates: documents and fee in foreign currency at GMERS Medical College, Gandhinagar.
Round 1 choice filling closed 2 Nov, 5 pm; choice locking until 11:55 pm.
GGSIPU state and institutional quota: Round 1 offline counselling on 2 Nov.
NEIGRIHMS Round 1 counselling on 2 Nov from 11 am (UGMC building, hybrid).

updates.text: Round 1 reporting at NAMO Medical Education & Research Institute, Silvassa, from 2 Nov; admission confirmation until 10 Nov.
Deficient documents of SC category candidates accepted until 3 Nov, noon.
Grievances against the provisional merit lists and the not-eligible lists closed 3 Nov, 1 pm.
Round 1 common allotment out: 197 direct and 177 in-service candidates (MD/MS and DNB); 107 seats left vacant. Search it by CMR, college, course, quota and category on the Odisha roadmap.

Notice 69: report for Round 1 admission at 650 LT, MKCG Medical College, Berhampur (10 am – 1 pm) with the listed original documents. Admission fees: ₹58,800 for MD/MS in government colleges (plus university fees), ₹1,25,000 for diploma and DNB; private college fees as listed.
Notice 81: pay the admission fee through SBI Collect (Convener PG Medical Counselling Committee, category PG MED ADMISSION FEES) or by bank draft payable at SBI MCC Branch, Berhampur.
Kerala on the roadmap: state merit list (5,665, with category-wise ranks), seat matrix (1,173 seats) and the first phase allotment (1,082). CEE publishes application numbers, not names.
Maharashtra on the roadmap: final state merit list (7,242) and in-service list (65), and the CAP Round 1 seat matrix (2,759 seats in government, private and minority colleges).
Notice 4, revised CAP Round 1 schedule: final merit lists and seat matrix 2 Nov; preference filling 2–4 Nov, until 11:59 pm; first selection list 5 Nov; joining 6–10 Nov, until 5:30 pm.
Karnataka seat matrix on the roadmap: 4,892 Round 1 seats (PG medical, DNB, DNB diploma and St John's), with KEA's provisional fee beside each seat.
Round 1 schedule: provisional allotment 5 Nov after 8 pm, final allotment 6 Nov after 11 am. Options entered for Round 1 carry over to Round 2.
Government order: PG fees in private medical colleges for 2026-27 stay at the 2025-26 levels (clinical courses ₹7,68,108 on government-quota seats, ₹13,72,994 on private-quota seats).

CAP Round 1 provisional selection list out: 2,112 candidates allotted (government, private, minority, NRI and in-service seats). Join in person 6–10 Nov, until 5:30 pm; the status retention form is due by 10 Nov, 5:30 pm. Search it by state merit rank on the Maharashtra roadmap.

Round 1 provisional allotment out: 3,272 MD/MS seats allotted, each with its course fee. Objections by email to keauthority-ka@nic.in before 10 am on 6 Nov; the final allotment follows on 6 Nov, after 11 am. Search it by NEET-PG rank on the Karnataka roadmap.

In-service quota: 15 post-MBBS DNB seats and 2 post-MBBS diploma seats (DME, DHS and IMS service quotas) added to the Kerala seat matrix, from the prospectus approved on 19 Oct. DNB fee ₹1,25,000 a year, paid online at allotment.

Madhya Pradesh on the roadmap: revised state merit list (4,777), Round 1 seat charts (2,169 seats in government, private and district hospitals) and the Round 1 allotment (1,110 allotted). Admission stays withheld under the High Court's interim order of 2 Nov.

Government and autonomous colleges' fees for 2026: tuition ₹1,00,000 a year and student fund ₹1,500 a year, plus refundable caution money ₹3,000 and security deposit ₹10,000 at admission (₹1,14,500 in all; hostel extra). In-service candidates register from 10 Oct; their category is updated to in-service after registration.
Round 1 provisional allotment out: Government quota 1,409, Management quota 468 (including CMC, minority and NRI seats) and DNB / 2-year diploma 11. Search it by rank on the Tamil Nadu roadmap.

Round 1 admission: choose freeze or float online and upload your documents; freeze candidates pay the advance tuition fee online (government colleges ₹60,000 a year with bond, ₹5,00,000 a year without bond for clinical subjects and pathology, ₹1,00,000 for other non-clinical subjects; private colleges ₹10,00,000), then report with the originals by 10 Nov. A freeze candidate who does not confirm admission loses the seat.

Round 1 allotment notice: candidates allotted government colleges complete scrutiny and admission at their college; those allotted Shri Balaji, Raipur Institute and Shri Shankaracharya (private) at the Shikshak Prashikshan Sansthan building, Pt. Deendayal Upadhyay Memorial Health Sciences and AYUSH University, Uparwara, Nava Raipur.
